def skill_dirs():
    return sorted(p for p in SKILLS.iterdir() if (p / "SKILL.md").is_file())


def read_fm(skill_dir):
    text = (skill_dir / "SKILL.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    m = FM_RE.match(text)
    assert m, f"{skill_dir.name}: no frontmatter"
    return yaml.safe_load(m.group(1))


def write_skill(root, name, fm, body="Body.\n"):
    d = root / "skills" / name
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (d / "SKILL.md").write_text(
        "---\n" + yaml.safe_dump(fm, sort_keys=False) + "---\n" + body,
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    return d


def base_fm(name="demo", **extra):
    fm = {"name": name, "description": "Use when testing.", "license": "MIT"}
    fm.update(extra)
    return fm


def header(deps="", requires="'>=3.11'"):
    return (
        "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n"
        "# /// script\n"
        f"# requires-python = {requires}\n"
        f"# dependencies = [{deps}]\n"
        "# ///\n"
    )


def header_block_lines(text):
    lines = text.splitlines()
    start = lines.index("# /// script")
    end = lines.index("# ///", start + 1)
    return lines[start : end + 1]

def _prov_repo(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / "LICENSE").write_text("MIT root\n")
    (tmp_path / "LICENSE-x").write_text("third party\n")
    for s in ("a", "b"):
        (tmp_path / "skills" / s).mkdir(parents=True)
    (tmp_path / "skills" / "a" / "LICENSE").write_text("MIT root\n")
    (tmp_path / "skills" / "a" / "LICENSE-x").write_text("third party\n")
    (tmp_path / "skills" / "b" / "LICENSE").write_text("MIT root\n")
    return tmp_path, ["a", "b"], {"LICENSE-x": ("a",)}

    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
